rule: Local HGSS art, reduced by medoids in Lab (the most distinct original tones kept farthest-first, every other tone joining its nearest), each family within its own tones: sea 7 (the shore rim in land cells takes the nearest rock, rim or road tone), pier 5, sea boulders 4, land boulders 4, cave mouth 2 (with the rock ramp), east-west stair planks the nearest pier tone, flowers 4, light lawn 3. The viaduct takes the nearest of Violet palette 11's greys.
